name: Cmail Identity + Social Onboarding
one_liner: Provision the reusable identity surface every agent-operated business needs: domain, DNS, email, phone and handles.
core_thesis: Business onboarding repeatedly needs the same identity acquisition DAG. This should be a reusable capability rather than reimplemented per vertical. Agents may exercise identity-management authority but must never possess raw credentials; purchases and irreversible actions require explicit grants/H-tasks.
why_now: AgentCom, BreadUp storefronts and future plugin businesses all reuse the same bootstrap machinery.
user: Any project that needs a real business identity
job: Safely get online identities wired with a precise list of unavoidable human blockers.
distribution: Internal shared service exposed through AgentCom/MCP.
moat: Platform-specific onboarding knowledge, blocker taxonomy and measured autonomy rates.
falsifiers: Identity platforms require so much manual verification that reuse is low.
Credential brokerage cannot support required providers safely.

success_definition: All 12 checkpoints PROVEN on live evidence, with no unresolved critical H-task or security gate.

repo_binding.polling: GitHub snapshots are implementation evidence only; checkpoint proof comes from validator receipts.

software_substitution_test.counterfactual: OpenAI/platform vendors ship perfect software for every reproducible feature in this project tomorrow.
surviving_value: delegated control of real business identities/resources
software_substitution_test.rationale: Provisioning code is replaceable. Permission to manage a company domain/number/email on its behalf is consequential external state.

underengineer.rule: Choose the earliest real-world event that increases controlled scarce state; build only its prerequisites plus safety and verification.
underengineer.scarce_state_target: Safely manage one real identity resource for one live campaign
underengineer.minimal_live_product: For one real business/campaign, obtain delegated DNS or email authority and complete one externally verifiable change without exposing credentials to the worker.

steps.action: Bind one owner grant to one resource/capability
steps.acceptance: Grant scope and expiry are explicit.

steps.action: Perform one real change through credential broker
Store only capability reference and receipt

underengineer.graduation_rule: The same bounded identity authority is reused by at least two asset campaigns or one customer repeatedly.
underengineer.kill_or_rethink_rule: If provider restrictions force raw credential exposure or manual work for every action, keep it narrow rather than generalizing.
underengineer.project_manager_invariant: A feature may enter NOW only if it is necessary to reach the first real moat event, required for safety/verification, or empirically unblocks that path.
underengineer.observation_pause: After the first live moat event, stop expanding and inspect customer/outcome evidence before choosing the next feature.

full_roadmap_policy: The original checkpoint ladder is a capability library, not default build order. UNDERENGINEER chooses the live minimum path.

experiment_strategy.learning_goal: Validate delegated identity changes with no credential exposure.
